results.title: Junta Strips 5 More Exiled Critics of Nationality
results.snippet: According to Niger’s press agency, the junta’s latest action brings the number of people provisionally deprived of Nigerien nationality under the 2024 order to 25. In October 2024, the junta provisionally stripped nine people linked to former President Bazoum of their nationality.
